name: ToxicIgnition / head

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. Head exploding like a ripe pumpkin: deep wet pop, crunchy rupture, broad pulp splatter and dripping.  Element: A wet tendon snap engulfed by a muffled gas ignition, followed by sustained rough flame licking and dry poisonous spore flutter with small charred Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
